reasons.claim: Two co-transmitters open the chain at one level and both take it from Sufyan.
reasons.quote: حدثنا عثمان بن أبي شيبة، وأحمد بن عبدة، - المعنى - أن سفيان بن عيينة، أخبرهم

reasons.claim: The chain then runs singly to Umar, who is the last link quoted on the Prophet's property.
reasons.quote: عن عمرو بن دينار، عن الزهري، عن مالك بن أوس بن الحدثان، عن عمر، قال

reasons.claim: The dashed «المعنى» is an editor's gloss and the remarks of Ibn Abda only give his wording, so neither adds a link.
reasons.quote: قال ابن عبدة في الكراع والسلاح

reasons.claim: The stored chain dropped Sufyan and fused the gloss into a name, so the readers' reading is better than it.
reasons.quote: أحمد بن عبدة - المعنى

reasons.claim: The first isnad runs Qutayba, Abd al-Aziz, Suhayl and then defers to an earlier chain.
reasons.quote: وحدثناه قتيبة بن سعيد، حدثنا عبد العزيز، - يعني الدراوردي - عن سهيل، بهذا الإسناد

reasons.claim: A second isnad opens with its own «وحدثنيه» and also ends in a back reference, so it is its own group.
reasons.quote: وحدثنيه محمد بن عبد الله بن بزيع، حدثنا يزيد بن زريع، حدثنا روح بن القاسم، حدثنا سهيل بن أبي صالح، بهذا الإسناد

reasons.claim: The words after the second back reference are wording differences, not transmitters.
reasons.quote: وقال بدل عقصاء عضباء

reasons.claim: The stored chain wrongly holds the verb «ساق» as a name, which the readers correctly left out.
reasons.quote: ساق

reviews.uncertainty_note: The structure written here is settled, but the earlier report «بهذا الإسناد» points to is not in the packet, so the chain beyond Suhayl cannot be completed or checked.

reviews.question: Unruled: al-Faqih's statement of the compiler's routes to a source («و ما كان فيه عن ... فقد رويته») with no saying; should it be stored as chains at all?

reasons.claim: The report is the compiler's statement of his routes to a source's material, with no saying after it.
reasons.quote: و ما كان فيه عن الحسين بن المختار فقد رويته عن أبي

reasons.claim: If it is stored, the readers' first group is structurally right: four co-transmitters converge with «جميعا» on one name.
reasons.quote: عن سعد بن عبد اللّه؛ و الحميريّ؛ و محمّد بن يحيى العطّار؛ و أحمد بن إدريس جميعا عن محمّد ابن الحسين بن أبي الخطّاب

reasons.claim: If it is stored, the second «رويته» is a separate route with its own names, as both readers read it.
reasons.quote: و قد رويته عن محمّد بن الحسين- رضي اللّه عنه- عن الحسين بن الحسن بن أبان

reviews.uncertainty_note: The structure is clear; only the owner's ruling on route statements is missing.

reasons.claim: Qutayba gives two branches, through Abd al-Aziz and through Yaqub.
reasons.quote: حدثنا عبد العزيز، - يعني ابن أبي حازم - وقال قتيبة حدثنا يعقوب

reasons.claim: Both branches meet in a tail written once, ending at Sahl b. Sa'd.
reasons.quote: كلاهما عن أبي حازم، عن سهل بن سعد

reasons.claim: The mention of Malik's version is a remark comparing wording, not a route of this saying.
reasons.quote: بمثل حديث مالك

reasons.claim: The stored chain cut the tail before Sahl and mixed the branches, so it is not preferred.
reasons.quote: يعقوب

reviews.question: Unruled: al-Faqih's statement of the compiler's routes to a source («و ما كان فيه عن ... فقد رويته») with no saying; if stored, should «عنهم» in the second route be expanded to the three shaykhs named before it in this same report?

reasons.claim: The report is the compiler's statement of his routes to a source's material, with no saying after it.
reasons.quote: و ما كان فيه عن ثعلبة بن ميمون فقد رويته عن أبي؛

reasons.claim: The first route has three co-transmitters at the first level, joined by «؛».
reasons.quote: عن أبي؛ و محمّد بن الحسن؛ و محمّد بن موسى بن المتوكّل

reasons.claim: The second route opens with a pronoun pointing back to those three shaykhs, which both readers left as a bare back reference.
reasons.quote: و رويته أيضا عنهم، عن الحميريّ

reviews.uncertainty_note: The structure is clear; the owner's ruling on route statements and on expanding an in-report «عنهم» is missing.

reasons.claim: The chain runs singly from Ishaq to Hudhayfa, who is quoted praying with the Prophet.
reasons.quote: عن طلحة بن يزيد الأنصاري، عن حذيفة، أنه صلى مع رسول الله

reasons.claim: The dashed «ثقة» is an editor's grading and not part of a name, which the stored chain wrongly kept.
reasons.quote: النضر بن محمد المروزي - ثقة

reasons.claim: The compiler's closing note reports how other transmitters gave this chain, a remark about another version and not a route of this saying.
reasons.quote: وغير العلاء بن المسيب قال في هذا الحديث عن طلحة عن رجل عن حذيفة

variant_verdicts.quote: وغير العلاء بن المسيب قال في هذا الحديث عن طلحة عن رجل عن حذيفة
وغير العلاء بن المسيب قال في هذا الحديث عن طلحة عن رجل عن حذيفة

reasons.claim: The report opens with a back reference: Layth is the asker and the one asked is only a pronoun.
reasons.quote: وَ سَأَلَهُ لَيْثٌ اَلْمُرَادِيُّ

reasons.claim: The nearest previous report names the source it relays, so the one asked is inherited from it.
reasons.quote: عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ

reasons.claim: Reader A's inherited name is the asker of the earlier report, not the one asked, so it cannot fill the place of the one who answers.
reasons.quote: وَ رُوِيَ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُهُ

reasons.claim: Reader B stops at the asker, leaving out the one asked who answers, who is a link in his place.
reasons.quote: قَالَ «نَعَمْ إِنَّمَا يُكْرَهُ اَلْمُلْحَمُ.

notes: «وَ سَأَلَهُ» is a back reference: Layth asks, and the one asked is the source named in prev1 («عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ»); al-Halabi in prev2 is an asker, not the one asked.

reviews.uncertainty_note: prev1 is a short version note rather than a full report, so a person should confirm that its named source is the one the pronoun points to.

reasons.claim: The chain runs singly from Abu Kamil to Shahr, with the dashed words an editor's gloss.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبو كامل، حدثنا عبد العزيز، - يعني ابن المختار - حدثنا ثابت، عن شهر بن حوشب

reasons.claim: Shahr asks Umm Salama and she answers, so she is the last link.
reasons.quote: قال سألت أم سلمة

reasons.claim: The compiler's note on Harun and Musa is a remark about another version, not a route of this saying.
reasons.quote: ورواه هارون النحوي وموسى بن خلف عن ثابت كما قال عبد العزيز

reasons.claim: The stored chain stopped at Shahr and lacked the one who answers.
reasons.quote: شهر بن حوشب

variant_verdicts.quote: ورواه هارون النحوي وموسى بن خلف عن ثابت كما قال عبد العزيز
ورواه هارون النحوي وموسى بن خلف عن ثابت كما قال عبد العزيز

reasons.claim: The first branch stops at Abu Usama only because «ح» switches to the second branch; it is not a chain that ends there.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبو أسامة، ح وحدثنا إسحاق بن منصور

reasons.claim: The second branch's own head ends at al-Nadr, and from Bahz on the chain is written once with «عن», so it is the tail shared by both branches.
reasons.quote: أنبأنا النضر بن شميل، عن بهز بن حكيم، عن أبيه، عن جده، معاوية القشيري

reasons.claim: Both readers left the first route ending at Abu Usama with no source, which the hold also flags.
reasons.quote: branch 1 stops at أبو أسامة

reasons.claim: The grandfather is named after a comma, so «جده» and the name are one link, the last before the Prophet.
reasons.quote: عن جده، معاوية القشيري قال قال رسول الله

notes: «ح» splits the head: Abu Bakr and Abu Usama, then Ishaq and al-Nadr; «عن بهز بن حكيم، عن أبيه، عن جده، معاوية القشيري» is written once and shared by both branches.

reviews.uncertainty_note: The join at Bahz follows the change from «أنبأنا» to «عن» after the second head; a join one link earlier is grammatically possible but much less likely.

reviews.question: Who says «ح وحدثني أبو عثمان»: the compiler, or a narrator inside the first chain (so the second branch shares its head)? The text writes no «قال X» before it; also, under ruling 9 and 10 Umar speaks a second saying inside Uqba's story and should be a last link of a second saying, which both readers left out.

reasons.claim: The second branch opens with a singular «وحدثني» and no named speaker, so the text alone does not show where it joins the first chain.
reasons.quote: عن عقبة بن عامر، ح وحدثني أبو عثمان، عن جبير بن نفير

reasons.claim: The compiler's own opening also uses «حدثني», so the verb does not settle who speaks the second branch.
reasons.quote: حدثني محمد بن حاتم بن ميمون

reasons.claim: Uqba first hears a saying from the Prophet himself, ending the first saying at Uqba.
reasons.quote: فأدركت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قائما يحدث الناس فأدركت من قوله

reasons.claim: Inside the story Umar speaks and relays a second saying, so under the narrated-encounter and two-sayings rulings he is the last link of that second saying, not a mere bystander as both readers held.
reasons.quote: فنظرت فإذا عمر قال إني قد رأيتك جئت آنفا قال

reasons.claim: Reader A excluded Umar as only present in the story.
reasons.quote: Umar is in the story, not a link

reviews.uncertainty_note: The join point of the «ح» branch is not settled by the words of the text, and the reading is already applied on the site.
